page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.14xlarge is a dedicated GPU-accelerated instance within the ecs.gn5 family, driven by KVM virtualization across an x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance provides 54 dedicated vCPUs accompanied by 480.0 GB of system memory, establishing a memory-to-core allocation of approximately 8.89 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by eight integrated NVIDIA P100 graphics processing units, which supply an aggregate of 128 GB of VRAM.

Integrated local storage is provisioned as 3,779 GB of solid-state drive (SSD) capacity directly attached to the system, facilitating workloads that require rapid access to extensive local datasets. Networking throughput is defined by a baseline transfer rate of 25 Gbps. The server does not bundle any complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating VPC network configurations or external gateway attachments for public network communication.

From an infrastructure and resource efficiency perspective, the platform consolidates massive parallel processing capacity by pairing eight enterprise accelerators with substantial system memory and local SSD storage within a single tenant configuration. While the multi-GPU topology avoids the multi-node network synchronization overhead typical of distributed smaller nodes, the NVIDIA P100 graphics architecture lacks later-generation tensor acceleration instructions, trading newer specialized precision formats for sheer parallel execution capacity.

The ecs.gn5-c8g1.14xlarge instance is structured for parallel computational pipelines, including distributed machine learning model training, high-capacity scientific simulation, video processing, and GPU-accelerated scientific analytics.
